name: Entrance Hall
summary: An entrance hall lit by a single brass oil lamp. The silver salver beside the lamp is empty, a dried ring of water left on it; above the lamp hangs a half-length portrait of the master, his face lost in shadow. The stairs climb to the right to the upper floor, the back corridor leads out to the garden, and a narrow door on the left is the butler's room. A few spots of wet mud on the floor trail away towards the back corridor.
